titulo.alumno: Conceding a hypothesis with «としても»

intro: Look at the pattern in short examples and check what information it gives in context.

piezas.titulo: «としても» concedes a hypothetical condition and states that the conclusion still holds.
texto: It's equivalent to "although" or "even if". Distinguish the hypothesis (unconfirmed) from a real fact, which would take にもかかわらず.
計画 が 遅れる と しても、安全 の 確認 は 省けません。 (Even if the plan were delayed, the safety check can't be skipped.)
反対 意見 が 多い と しても、理由 を 聞かず に 結論 を 出す べき では ありません。 (Even if there are many opposing opinions, one shouldn't reach a conclusion without hearing the reasons.)
